# Jesus’ Birth (Luke 2:7)

## Emotional Focus
Wonder that God sent Jesus as a tiny baby because He loves us.

## Key KJV
“And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger.” (Luke 2:7)

## Gentle Retelling
God loved the world so much that He sent His Son Jesus to be born as a little baby in a stable. Mary wrapped Him and laid Him in a manger. Angels sang and shepherds came to see the tiny King.

## Coloring Prompt
Baby Jesus in the manger with Mary and Joseph, gentle animals, and soft starlight above.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus came because God loves you so much.”
